title: Windows fixture directory check silently measures the raw spelling when canonicalization fails
outcome: windows_fixture_directory_check in src/test_temp_paths.rs canonicalizes the directory before applying the 67-byte budget. When canonicalize fails, it falls back to the original spelling, so a short alias can pass unmeasured and a later fixture operation fails without the placement diagnostic. Both callers now create the directory first, so a canonicalization failure should instead return a diagnostic naming the directory and the OS error. Found by the Codex reviewer in round 3 (delegation-8cbb4084-c485-4e69-b2e2-1a8d1b905fb9) of the review that landed the fixture budget; Low.
acceptance: Windows fixture directory check silently measures the raw spelling when canonicalization fails is done
